simple.meaning: Javan , the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָוָן (H3120) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 11 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָוָן (Yâvân) means Javan , the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 5.

definitions.short: Javan , the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia
definitions.full: H3120. Yavan ארנבן proper name, of a location whence wine , so Co Ezek 27:19 for וְיָוָן וְדָן ᵑ0 ; compare Assyrian wine of Aranabanim . יָוָן proper name, of a people Ionia ns), Greece (Greek Ἰάονες (i.e. originally Ἰάονες ), see also ᵐ5 below; Old Persian Yauna Spieg APK 237 ; Assyrian Iamanu (Iavanu) Dl Pa 248 ff. COT Gloss ; Egyptian Y:e-v:a-n-(n)a, see WMM 369f. compare also 24 ff.; see especially on this word Sta De Populo Javan 1880 ) — Ionians , as traders Ezek 27:13 , ᵐ5 Ἑλλάς (named with מֶשֶׁךְ תּוּבַל, ; in 27:12 תַּרְשִׁישׁ in 27:14 תּוֺגַרְמָה ); compare יְוָנִי (adjective, of a people) below; as distant, Isa 66:19 , ᵐ5 Ἑλλάς (with תּוּבַל לוּד, מּוּל, תַּרְשִׁישׁ, and הָֽרְחֹקִים הָאִיִּים ; list to be emended from ᵐ5 Sta ib. 5 ff. ); called 'son' of Japhet Gen 10:2 (P) = 1Chr 1:5 , and 'father' of כִּתִּים תַּרְשִׁישׁ, אֱלִישָׁא, and רֹדָנִים (so read for דֹדָנִים ) Gen 10:4 (P) = 1Chr 1:7 (in these ᵐ5 Ιωυναν, see Lag BN 84 Anm. **); addressed (personified) יָוָן בָּנַיִךְ Zech 9:13 (opposed to צִיּוֺן בניך ) ᵐ5 Ἕλληνες, and so in following; יָוָן מֶלֶךְ Dan 8:21 (see וּפָרָ֑ס מָדַי מַלְכֵי 8:20 ) = king of Greece i.e. kingdom over which Alexander ruled, whose dominion was afterward divided (see 8:22 ff.); שַׂריָֿוָן 10:20 of the guardian-angel of Greece (see מָּרָס שַׂר v a ); יָוָן מַלְכוּת 11:2 (v:b מָּרַֹס ). — Ezek 27:19 וְיָוָן is textual error, see וְדָן above.
